auditor_value: Both true and the Reason explains: T ∝ √H so T₁/T₂ = 2; equal ranges R = uₓT give uₓ₁/uₓ₂ = T₂/T₁ = 1/2, i.e. 1 : 2.

findings.quote: Equal heights fix the ratio of vertical launch speeds
findings.note: The two heights in this question are 4H and H, not equal; equal heights would give a ratio of 1. The sentence misdescribes the data the argument starts from.
findings.fix: The given heights 4H and H fix the ratio of vertical launch speeds, which fixes the ratio of flight times, and equal ranges then fix the ratio of horizontal launch speeds.

notes: Every equation line checks: uᵧ₁/uᵧ₂ = 2, T₁/T₂ = 2, uₓ₁·2T₂ = uₓ₂·T₂ so uₓ₁/uₓ₂ = 1/2. The option-4 mistake entry (inverting the ratio to 2 : 1, so the student rejects the Assertion) is genuine.
